description: This is despite the initial investigation into Epstein's death occurred during his first presidency, and that he had authority to release any additional files then. These facts were never commented on.
headline: Donald Trump Says That he Would Declassify Epstein Files, if Elected, in Fox News Interview

info.description: He goes on to describe ambiguously why it might be good to release the files.
info.note: This part was edited out of the orginal interview, but was included in a later radio show.
